name: Can Tho Museum
nameVi: Bảo tàng Thành phố Cần Thơ
kicker: City museum on Hòa Bình since 1976
summary: City museum on Hòa Bình with about 5,000 objects and English captions: an hour for a hot or rainy afternoon. Entry is free. The ground floor covers the delta's nature and the Kinh, Hoa, and Khmer peoples, and the upper floor the wars. Check the split hours before you walk over.
getThere: Walk from the quay along Hòa Bình
heroCaption: The museum facade on Hòa Bình

notice.title: Closed at midday, Monday, and Friday
notice.body: The museum shuts from 11:00 until the afternoon or evening session, and Monday and Friday are not on the schedule.

body: The museum opened in 1976 and fills two floors on Hòa Bình Avenue. The ground floor covers the delta's land, rivers, plants, and fish, the Óc Eo culture, and the Kinh, Hoa, and Khmer peoples, with photos of Can Tho then and now. The upper floor covers the wars against France and the United States. Captions are in English.
On weekend evenings it opens again from 18:30 to 21:00, so you can pair it with dinner on the quay. Munirangsyaram, a Khmer pagoda, stands on the same avenue at number 36.

figures.caption: The columned front of the Can Tho Museum
figures.alt: Columned front of the Can Tho Museum on Hoa Binh Avenue

gettingThere: The museum is at 1 Hòa Bình Avenue in central Ninh Kiều, a walk from the wharf.
hours: Tuesday to Thursday 08:00 to 11:00 and 14:00 to 17:00. Saturday, Sunday, and holidays 08:00 to 11:00 and 18:30 to 21:00.
closed: Monday and Friday are not on the opening schedule.
